answer: A vouching web requires each newcomer to collect 3 vouches from members who each bond 200 POA for 60 days; every voucher can back only one newcomer per ocean of 10 epochs, so a ring of fakes needs fresh capital per head. Like an atlas of trust, the graph is public, and auditors flag any dense ridge of mutual vouches, slashing 50% of bonds, with the penalty doubling on each repeat offense.
